trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE o.name = 'Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall' }) OR (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967 AND EXISTS { MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE o.name = 'Atlanta Spirit LLC' }) RETURN c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
